items.question: Under what numerical condition are beings tormented within womb-diagrams across thousands of such forms?
premises: Eighty-four appears as a fixed numerical count here.
Thousands mark a large set of womb-diagrams.
Beings are described as tormented within those womb-diagrams.
items.inference: Beings are tormented in eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: Exact scope of yoniyantra remains context-dependent.
